retention.behind_other: {{count}} rows are past their retention window and still present — the purge job is behind.

headline.sendingStubHint: No real provider — nothing is being delivered
headline.failedHint: Each one is a message nobody received. Check the delivery table below.
headline.suppressedHint: Bounced or marked as spam; these are never mailed again

idle.hint: The queue is empty — everything due has been handed to a provider.
idle.announcement: The email queue is empty. Everything due has been sent.

flowing.hint: Normal. Messages are being picked up and delivered.
flowing.announcement: The email queue is moving. The oldest message has been waiting {{duration}}.

stalled.hint: Too long. Messages are due but nothing is collecting them — the dispatcher may have stopped.
stalled.announcement: Warning: the email queue has stalled. The oldest message has been waiting {{duration}} and nothing is collecting it.

suppressions.title: Blocked addresses
suppressions.description: An address that bounced permanently or reported spam is never mailed again. Addresses are stored as a one-way hash, so only the reason is shown here.
suppressions.listCaption: Individual blocked addresses, shown as hashes
suppressions.lifted: That address can receive email again.
suppressions.liftHelp: Type the full address. Only unblock after the person has confirmed the mailbox works — mailing a dead address again damages delivery for everyone.

empty.title: No blocked addresses
empty.description: Nothing has bounced permanently or been reported as spam.
